criteria.why: Five independent settings motivate exact position-to-membership representation, with zero-based rightmost bit and decimal21.
criteria.naive: Boolean-array alternative and per-position combination; single-word width is a limit, not arbitrary-size compression.
criteria.observation: Binary positional sum and per-bit AND/OR/XOR/NOT semantics; no addition-style carries.
criteria.method: Single-bit test/set/clear/toggle separated; whole-set complement restricted toU=2^w-1.
criteria.example: Five-bit trace0→4→20→16→15→14, explicit membership/count outputs and repeated-clear versus toggle distinction.
criteria.proof: Command induction preserves allowed-width state; nonzero x&(x-1) removes exactly one rightmost set bit and terminates.
criteria.time: Fixed-word operation constant but count loops once per member; total O(q(w+1)), constant auxiliary space, w<=60.
criteria.implementation: Four explained exact fragments: counting copy, bounded state, count/complement branches, indexed commands; complete C++17 last.
criteria.boundaries: Width0 has no indexed commands, width60/index59 safe, typed one before shift, valid-command and unsigned contracts explicit.
criteria.mistakes: Logical versus bitwise operators, XOR not exponentiation, precedence guard, subtraction cannot remove absent member, NOT must be width-masked.
criteria.connections: Set identities and prefix-XOR cancellation distinguished from sums. Reflected Gray construction proves adjacency including midpoint and unique complete coverage.
criteria.recognition: Exponential state enumeration remains expensive despite fitting one subset in a word; counts and arbitrary-size sets need other representations.
criteria.practice: All four old references retained, six stages; Gray direct core, subsetDP/greedy and IOI logic-gate network optional with extra requirements.
criteria.priority: High educational foundation; only existing304 priority fields proposedHigh; no blanket promotion of attached tasks.
criteria.mastery: Ordinary-set oracle, repeated commands, count-copy nonmutation and independent small Gray-list checks.

criteria.why: Equal cuts of48and18 distinguish common divisor from arbitrary divisor; connect to ratios and periods.
criteria.naive: Descending positive candidates correct but linear in smaller numerical input; no need enumerate all divisors.
criteria.observation: Both directions d|a,b iff d|b,r established algebraically froma=kb+r.
criteria.method: Save old remainder before sequential assignment; while second!=0; initially smaller first works without sorting.
criteria.example: Exact48,18→18,12→12,6→6,0 table; first remainder12 explicitly not the answer.
criteria.proof: Answer-preserving invariant plus strictly decreasing nonnegative second proves termination/correctness; gcd(0,0)=0 explicitly a convention.
criteria.time: At most two steps halve second via r<=b/2 or b%r=b-r; logarithmic remainder count under fixed-word model, constant auxiliary space.
criteria.implementation: Four explained exact fragments: Euclid helper, zero-safe lcm helper, main setup, per-query output; full standard4space C++17 last.
criteria.boundaries: Zero cases, prime-exponent lcm identity,1e9input→1e18product bound; dividing first alone does not prevent arbitrary larger overflow; positive guarda/g>L/b.
criteria.mistakes: Old input overwritten too soon, modulozero, gcd versus lcm and fast pair primitive does not justify all-pairs enumeration.
criteria.connections: Fraction reduction with nonzero denominator, prefixgcd fold, C++17std::gcd preconditions and minimum-signed abs caveat; extended Euclid explicitly deferred.
criteria.recognition: Gcd versus lcm use cases and divisor-count/sieve/frequency extensions separated.
criteria.practice: All five old task identities retained, six teaching stages plus optional PrimeMultiples; actual EGOIZeros interval-LCM extension verified against official explanation.
criteria.priority: High foundational invariant/termination skill; direct LargeLCM773 alreadyHigh unchanged; old divisor cores become optional because they need additional algorithms.
criteria.mastery: Both divisor-implication directions, exhaustive small oracle, zero/equal/divisible/coprime/Fibonacci/extreme pairs and numeric contract.
